page.layout: One block of verse on a single printed page: running head at top centre, page number at top right, all text in one column below.

main_text.l: Nil vita melius, morte nihil putant
Vmbris cuncta domat, gaudia quæ brevis
Gens ignara Dei, cæcáque non videt.
Sic post dura tibi funera nunc parens

page.notes: Verse lines are set in italic throughout; the italic marking is not repeated on each line. Some letters are doubtful in the scan, notably the long s and the ligatures in "nænias" and "faustitas", which may be misprints or worn type. The leading "V" of the first line and similar capitals are typographic.
